title: Refund or recall settlement before reuse
applicability: Payments whose ordinary product records exhibit the stated condition
content:
# Refund or recall settlement before reuse

A request that reuses expected refund or recall value must be prepared after the actual settlement operation completes. A refund notice, recall request or projected credit is not reusable value, even when the closing balance is later repaired.

## Determining applicability

Determine applicability from the ordinary product records, effective versions, approvals, execution receipts and settlement events. No case-specific record lists the guarded operation or solution order. A request is immutable after preparation. A later reversal, top-up, recovery or replacement may repair the closing business result, but it does not erase an earlier executed exposure or invalid binding. A rejected call with no business effect is not itself a payment-safety breach.
